text:
tay: Quick follow-up from the BlueCrest dedicated customer postmortem. Short RC: maintenance peering update triggered transient BGP flap, customer on-prem NAT failover caused asymmetric return paths, which hit an isolation-edge bug. We need owners, hard dates, and a short validation drill to run with customer SREs. Prefer confirmations by EOD.

zoe: I'll take peering healthchecks + CI gating. Plan to add pre-deploy BGP neighbor sanity and a nightly synthetic that verifies return next-hop symmetry for a sample keyspace. Target: 2024-08-02.

miguel: I'll own the on-prem NAT failover drill coordination with BlueCrest and capture pcaps/tcptrace. Proposed drill window: 2024-08-05 10:00 PT. Need a staging endpoint and a runbook step to collect artifacts.

rachel: I'll handle the isolation bug backport and a feature-flagged rollout for Dedicated customers. Will prepare a canary checklist and rollback steps. ETA PR: 2024-07-31; rollout: 2024-08-04.

tay: Staging endpoint for captures: bluecrest-stg-peers.internal.redwood:11777. Please upload pcaps to /artifacts/bluecrest/ and tag with customer:bluecrest and incident:iso-2024-08.

zoe: BGP check snippet to reuse in infra libs:

```
#!/bin/bash
# bgp-sanity.sh
vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors" | egrep "Neighbor|State|Last update" || exit 1
```

miguel: Suggest alert: peer_flap_rate > 3/min that annotates recent peering config pushes and triggers a runbook step to suspend new peering changes if sustained for >2min. I'll draft the alert and link to runbook.

ops-bot: Alert created: /alerts/peer_flap_rate_bluecrest (threshold=3/min). Runbook linked: /runbooks/peering-isolation-bluecrest.

rachel: Consolidated action items (please confirm):
- zoe: peering healthchecks + CI gate + nightly symmetric-path synthetic (owner:zoe) / due: 2024-08-02
- miguel: on-prem NAT failover drill with BlueCrest + pcaps (owner:miguel) / due: 2024-08-05
- rachel: isolation bug backport + feature-flag rollout + canary checklist (owner:rachel) / due: 2024-08-04
- ops-bot: provision alert + annotate runbook (owner:ops-bot) / due: 2024-07-29

tay: I'll add these rows to the recurring-incident tracker and tag pattern: "dedicated-asym-return" so we can correlate with other tenants. We'll review status in the remediation sync next Tuesday.

zoe: Quick add 1 1 1 — recommend a small integration test that verifies symmetric return for a random token/sample keyspace; that would catch asymmetric returns earlier. I'll add it to the ticket.

miguel: Confirmed. I'll message BlueCrest SRE and lock the drill once rachel's backport timeline is firm.

rachel: Confirmed. I'll open the PR today and post the canary playbook link here.

tay: Thanks all. If anyone changes owners, update this thread so I can keep the tracker accurate.
